data.question: I'm brand new to Obsidian. Is this too advanced?
data.answer: Not at all. OSK is designed for **beginners**. The user guide explains everything step by step, and the Getting Started Roadmap tells you what to learn first. Many people start with OSK on their very first day with `Obsidian`.

data.question: What's new in v6?
data.answer: v6 brings what I added to my vault since v5: a **Media Management System** (movies, shows, anime, manga, comics, video games, board games and albums, with what you own, want, lent and finished), a **Music Learning System** (chords, scales and songs with mastery levels and spaced review), **session notes** that give your activities their time, AI skills for your creations and for the plugins behind the Quick Actions, bundles of notes for a chat AI, **renames that keep your links**, link checks, Kanban boards that handle thousands of cards and work on your phone, a French interface for the OSK plugin, `osk-cli` on macOS, and much faster saves on large vaults. Everything else (and there's a LOT) is in the [v6.0.0 release notes](https://notes.dsebastien.net/30+Areas/33+Permanent+notes/33.04+Creations/Products/Obsidian+Starter+Kit/Release+Notes/Obsidian+Starter+Kit+-+Release+Notes+-+v6.0.0).

data.question: I'm on v5. How do I upgrade to v6?
data.answer: You don't re-import the kit. The [v5 to v6 migration guide](https://notes.dsebastien.net/30+Areas/33+Permanent+notes/33.04+Creations/Products/Obsidian+Starter+Kit/Migration+Guides/Obsidian+Starter+Kit+-+Migration+Guide+-+v5.0.2+to+v6.0.0) walks you through it step by step: the core update first, then the media, music and session systems if you want them, with a skill that moves your workout history out of your daily notes. Still on v4? Follow the [v4 to v5 migration guide](https://notes.dsebastien.net/30+Areas/33+Permanent+notes/33.04+Creations/Products/Obsidian+Starter+Kit/Migration+Guides/Obsidian+Starter+Kit+-+Migration+Guide+-+v4.x+to+v5.0.0) with the v6 kit; it already contains these changes.

data.question: What do I need to run it?
data.answer: `Obsidian` **1.15.0 or newer** (several bundled plugins need a recent version). The AI part is optional; for it, you need an AI coding agent such as `Claude Code`, and the skills that run scripts also need `bun`. Movie, comic and board game metadata need your own free API keys (TMDB, Comic Vine, BoardGameGeek), and the sport session notes need a Garmin Connect account or a Strava export. Everything else works without any of it.

data.question: Which AI tools does it work with?
data.answer: `Claude Code` gets everything: the `MCP` servers, on-demand skill search, the slash commands, the output styles and every safety hook. `Codex` gets the `MCP` servers and the hooks. `Gemini CLI` gets the hooks (you add the `MCP` servers yourself). `GitHub Copilot` in your IDE reads the vault rules and the skill files.

data.question: Where do I download v6?
data.answer: Where you bought the kit: your Gumroad library, or the Obsidian Starter Kit space in Knowii if you got it through the community. [learn.knowii.net](https://learn.knowii.net) explains both.

data.question: Won't AI just fill my vault with generic content?
data.answer: That's exactly what OSK is designed to prevent. The kit is built on a clear **AI Augmentation Philosophy**: AI augments your thinking; it never replaces it. The **identity layer** calibrates AI to your voice, values, and goals. **LLM Wikis** track sources and confidence for every claim. **Pre-publish review panels** (Editor, Skeptic, Hater, Beginner, Power User) catch generic output before it ships. AI handles the busywork; you stay the author. You can outsource the labor; you can't outsource your understanding.

data.question: Do I need AI tools to use OSK?
data.answer: No. OSK works great as a "classic" PKM system, and the user guide shows what to switch off if you want AI out of your vault entirely. When you're ready for AI, everything is already wired: agents, AI skills, LLM Wikis, an identity layer, and the OSK plugin (CLI + `MCP` server) that helps AI tools understand your whole vault. `Claude Code` and `Codex` connect to it on first launch.

data.question: I already have an Obsidian vault, or an older version of OSK. Can I migrate?
data.answer: Yes. Each major version of OSK comes with a step-by-step migration guide; the latest one takes you from v5 to v6 and keeps your setup. Starting from a vault of your own? Open OSK next to it and bring your notes in at your own pace; the user guide explains where each kind of note goes.

data.question: What if OSK doesn't fit my workflow?
data.answer: OSK is a starting point, not a straitjacket. **Everything is customizable**. Tweak the structure, templates, and plugins to match how you think. And if it's really not right for you, there's a **30-day money-back guarantee**.

data.question: How do updates work?
data.answer: **Every update is free, for life**, v6 and every version after it included. You download new versions where you bought the kit: your Gumroad library, or the Obsidian Starter Kit space in Knowii. I announce every release by email, and the release notes document every change.

data.question: Do I need to pay for Obsidian?
data.answer: No. `Obsidian` is **free**, including for work (the commercial license is optional). OSK is a pre-built vault plus documentation; the two are separate products.

data.question: Is support included?
data.answer: Yes. Email me your questions, or ask in the Obsidian Starter Kit space on the [Knowii Community](/product/knowii-community), which comes with your purchase. I answer questions myself and help people get started.

data.question: Can I use OSK for work or commercial purposes?
data.answer: Absolutely. Consultants, project managers and knowledge workers use OSK for their professional work. `Obsidian` itself is free for work too (the commercial license is optional).

data.question: What's the difference between Essentials and Premium?
data.answer: **Essentials** (**${product.variants.0.price|currency}**) includes the complete vault, the online user guide and every future update. **Premium** (**${product.variants.1.price|currency}**) adds the **Obsidian Starter Course**, a video course of over two hours on `Obsidian` and PKM fundamentals. Both are one-time purchases with free updates for life.
